fixtures.raw:
clear
load
  {app="a", pod="p1"} `{"ok":1}` @ 20s [metadata n="5" unrelated="u1"] # "unrelated" metadata is never named by a query
  {app="a", pod="p2"} `{`        @ 40s [metadata n="7" unrelated="u2"] # malformed
  {app="a", pod="p2"} `{`        @ 50s [metadata n="9" unrelated="u9"] # malformed, other metadata
  {app="c", pod="p3"} `{`        @ 40s [metadata n="9" __preserve_error__="true"] # malformed
  {app="noise", pod="p4"} `{"ok":1}` @ 20s [metadata n="9" unrelated="u3"]

eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__="" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  {pod="p1"} 5
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__="JSONParserErr" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", pod="p2"} 7
eval range from 20s to 60s step 20s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__="JSONParserErr" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod) # overlapping
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", pod="p2"} _ 7 7
# by() keeps no label of its own, so the kept sample reports only the error labels.
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__="JSONParserErr" | unwrap n [1m]) by ()
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error"} 7
# A clean line and an errored line in one result.
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="zzz" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  {pod="p1"} 5
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", pod="p2"} 7
# pod="p2" errored lines (2) differ only in metadata, which the grouping drops, so they form one series.
eval instant at 60s sum by (pod) (first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod))
  {pod="p2"} 7
# Structured metadata named __preserve_error__ is an ordinary field: it cannot keep the errored
# line by itself, only a __error__ filter in the query can.
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="c"} | json | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="c"} | json | __error__!="" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", pod="p3"} 9
eval range from 40s to 80s step 20s first_over_time({app="c"} | json | __error__!="" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod) # overlapping
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", pod="p3"} 9 9 9
eval instant at 60s sum without (pod) (count_over_time({app="c"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", __preserve_error__="true", app="c", n="9"} 1
# by() and without() on the vector aggregation without __error__ filter report the error.
eval instant at 60s sum by () (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | n!="9" [1m]))
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
eval instant at 60s sum without (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | n!="9" [1m]))
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
# by() and without() on the range aggregation without __error__ filter report the error.
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | unwrap n [1m]) by ()
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | unwrap n [1m]) without (pod)
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
# The __error__ filter decides on its own, so every grouping reports the same lines. Loki pushes the
# outer grouping into the extractor for sum() only, so each shape runs twice: sum() and max() must
# agree on whether the query runs, whatever their values.
eval instant at 60s sum by (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {pod="p2"} 2
eval instant at 60s max by (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {pod="p2"} 1
eval range from 40s to 60s step 20s sum by (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m])) # overlapping
  {pod="p2"} 1 2
eval range from 40s to 60s step 20s max by (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m])) # overlapping
  {pod="p2"} 1 1
eval instant at 60s sum (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {} 2
eval instant at 60s max (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {} 1
eval instant at 60s sum without (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", app="a", n="7", unrelated="u2"} 1
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", app="a", n="9", unrelated="u9"} 1
eval instant at 60s max without (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", app="a", n="7", unrelated="u2"} 1
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", app="a", n="9", unrelated="u9"} 1
# A __error__ filter after the unwrap.
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | unwrap n | __error__!="" [1m]) by (pod)
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", pod="p2"} 7

provenance.method: Standard-library Go AST plus bounded logqltest source extraction, following logfmt-ownership-producer.go.txt; no runtime evaluation. Both complete source SHA-256 values must match before extraction or output.

selections.purpose: complete Test_jsonParser_Parse declaration, schema and all 16 table rows
inert harness provenance: path tracking, hints, metadata, input immutability and flat label assertions
complete requested JSON block, including comments, whitespace and the in-block expression control at 169
selections.raw:
# json()
clear
load
  {app="a"} `{"level":"info","status":200}` @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 4]
  {app="noise"} `{"level":"info"}` @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 4]

eval instant at 60s count_over_time({app="a"} | json [1m])
  {app="a", level="info", status="200"} 3
eval range from 40s to 80s step 20s count_over_time({app="a"} | json [1m])  # overlapping
  {app="a", level="info", status="200"} 2 3 3
eval range from 60s to 180s step 120s count_over_time({app="a"} | json [1m]) # non-overlapping
  {app="a", level="info", status="200"} 3 _

# json() edge cases:
# - Nested objects flatten with `_`.
# - Numbers and booleans become strings.
# - Null and arrays drop.
clear
load
  {app="a"} `{"lvl":"warn","obj":{"x":1,"y":{"z":2}},"ok":true,"no":false,"nil":null,"arr":[1,2],"f":1.5}` @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 3]
  {app="noise"} `{"a":1}` @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 3]

eval instant at 60s count_over_time({app="a"} | json [1m])
  {app="a", lvl="warn", obj_x="1", obj_y_z="2", ok="true", no="false", f="1.5"} 3
eval range from 40s to 60s step 20s count_over_time({app="a"} | json [1m])  # overlapping
  {app="a", lvl="warn", obj_x="1", obj_y_z="2", ok="true", no="false", f="1.5"} 2 3

# json() edge cases:
# - A dotted key sanitizes to `_`.
# - A clashing name gets `_extracted`.
# - A duplicate key keeps the first.
clear
load
  {app="a", level="stream"} `{"level":"parsed","a.b":1,"dup":"first","dup":"second"}` @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 3]
  {app="noise"} `{"x":1}` @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 3]

eval instant at 60s count_over_time({app="a"} | json [1m])
  {app="a", level="stream", level_extracted="parsed", a_b="1", dup="first"} 3
eval range from 40s to 60s step 20s count_over_time({app="a"} | json [1m])  # overlapping
  {app="a", level="stream", level_extracted="parsed", a_b="1", dup="first"} 2 3

# json() clashing labels keep the loser under `<name>_extracted`, following the base-name
# precedence stream > metadata > parsed (the same for every parser).
clear
load
  {app="a", sl="s", sm="s", tri="s"} `{"sl":"p","md":"p","tri":"p"}` @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 3] [metadata md="m" sm="m" tri="m"]
  {app="noise"} `{"x":1}` @ 20s [repeat every 20s for 3]

eval instant at 60s count_over_time({app="a"} | json [1m])
  {app="a", sl="s", sl_extracted="p", md="m", md_extracted="p", sm="s", sm_extracted="m", tri="s", tri_extracted="p"} 3
eval range from 40s to 60s step 20s count_over_time({app="a"} | json [1m])
  {app="a", sl="s", sl_extracted="p", md="m", md_extracted="p", sm="s", sm_extracted="m", tri="s", tri_extracted="p"} 2 3
# json()'s label-expression form resolves the same clashes the same way.
eval instant at 60s count_over_time({app="a"} | json sl, md, sm, tri [1m])
  {app="a", sl="s", sl_extracted="p", md="m", md_extracted="p", sm="s", sm_extracted="m", tri="s", tri_extracted="p"} 3

# json() malformed line: the query fails, unless a __error__ filter drops the bad line.
clear
load
  {app="a"} `{"ok":1}` @ 20s
  {app="a"} `broken`   @ 40s
  {app="a"} `{"ok":1}` @ 60s
  {app="noise"} `{"z":1}` @ 20s

eval instant at 60s count_over_time({app="a"} | json [1m])
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
eval instant at 60s count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__="" [1m])
  {app="a", ok="1"} 2
# A malformed line outside the range vector duration cannot fail the query.
# (40s,60s] excludes the line at 40s, and (20s,40s] includes it.
eval instant at 60s count_over_time({app="a"} | json [20s])
  {app="a", ok="1"} 1
eval instant at 40s count_over_time({app="a"} | json [20s])
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
eval select from 0 to 60s forward {app="a"} | json | __error__!=""
  {app="a"} `broken` @ 40s [parsed __error__="JSONParserErr" __error_details__="Value looks like object, but can't find closing '}' symbol"]

# json() parsing error, that an __error__ filter, keeps in the result the series with the grouped labels
# plus the labels that report the error.
clear
load
  {app="a", pod="p1"} `{"ok":1}` @ 20s [metadata n="5" unrelated="u1"] # "unrelated" metadata is never named by a query
  {app="a", pod="p2"} `{`        @ 40s [metadata n="7" unrelated="u2"] # malformed
  {app="a", pod="p2"} `{`        @ 50s [metadata n="9" unrelated="u9"] # malformed, other metadata
  {app="c", pod="p3"} `{`        @ 40s [metadata n="9" __preserve_error__="true"] # malformed
  {app="noise", pod="p4"} `{"ok":1}` @ 20s [metadata n="9" unrelated="u3"]

eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__="" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  {pod="p1"} 5
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__="JSONParserErr" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", pod="p2"} 7
eval range from 20s to 60s step 20s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__="JSONParserErr" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod) # overlapping
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", pod="p2"} _ 7 7
# by() keeps no label of its own, so the kept sample reports only the error labels.
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__="JSONParserErr" | unwrap n [1m]) by ()
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error"} 7
# A clean line and an errored line in one result.
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="zzz" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  {pod="p1"} 5
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", pod="p2"} 7
# pod="p2" errored lines (2) differ only in metadata, which the grouping drops, so they form one series.
eval instant at 60s sum by (pod) (first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod))
  {pod="p2"} 7
# Structured metadata named __preserve_error__ is an ordinary field: it cannot keep the errored
# line by itself, only a __error__ filter in the query can.
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="c"} | json | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="c"} | json | __error__!="" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", pod="p3"} 9
eval range from 40s to 80s step 20s first_over_time({app="c"} | json | __error__!="" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod) # overlapping
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", pod="p3"} 9 9 9
eval instant at 60s sum without (pod) (count_over_time({app="c"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", __preserve_error__="true", app="c", n="9"} 1
# by() and without() on the vector aggregation without __error__ filter report the error.
eval instant at 60s sum by () (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | n!="9" [1m]))
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
eval instant at 60s sum without (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | n!="9" [1m]))
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
# by() and without() on the range aggregation without __error__ filter report the error.
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | unwrap n [1m]) by ()
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | unwrap n [1m]) without (pod)
  expect fail msg: JSONParserErr
# The __error__ filter decides on its own, so every grouping reports the same lines. Loki pushes the
# outer grouping into the extractor for sum() only, so each shape runs twice: sum() and max() must
# agree on whether the query runs, whatever their values.
eval instant at 60s sum by (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {pod="p2"} 2
eval instant at 60s max by (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {pod="p2"} 1
eval range from 40s to 60s step 20s sum by (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m])) # overlapping
  {pod="p2"} 1 2
eval range from 40s to 60s step 20s max by (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m])) # overlapping
  {pod="p2"} 1 1
eval instant at 60s sum (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {} 2
eval instant at 60s max (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {} 1
eval instant at 60s sum without (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", app="a", n="7", unrelated="u2"} 1
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", app="a", n="9", unrelated="u9"} 1
eval instant at 60s max without (pod) (count_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__!="" [1m]))
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", app="a", n="7", unrelated="u2"} 1
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", app="a", n="9", unrelated="u9"} 1
# A __error__ filter after the unwrap.
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | unwrap n | __error__!="" [1m]) by (pod)
  {__error__="JSONParserErr", __error_details__="Malformed JSON error", pod="p2"} 7

# json() error replaced by the unwrap conversion error.
clear
load
  {app="a", pod="p1"} `{"v":10}` @ 20s [metadata n="10"]
  {app="a", pod="p1"} `{`        @ 40s [metadata n="abc"] # fails json(), then fails the conversion
  {app="noise", pod="p2"} `{`    @ 40s [metadata n="abc"]

# A failed unwrap conversion generates a sample value of 0 when errored lines are preserved by using __error__ filter.
eval instant at 60s first_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__=~".*" | unwrap n [1m]) by (pod)
  {pod="p1"} 10
  {__error__="SampleExtractionErr", __error_details__="strconv.ParseFloat: parsing \"abc\": invalid syntax", pod="p1"} 0
eval instant at 60s min (avg_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__=~".*" | unwrap n [1m]))
  {} 0
# Counting the number of series should match.
eval instant at 60s count by (pod) (sum_over_time({app="a"} | json | __error__=~".*" | unwrap n [1m]))
  {pod="p1"} 2

replay.engine: All times, steps and repeat intervals are integer seconds relative to upstream epoch 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z (logqltest/parser.go:19-25). Replay may shift an entire fixture to a deterministic retained epoch while preserving every relative timestamp. Repeat count includes the first entry: expand start+i*every for i=0..count-1 (parser.go:129-134). Preserve load order, noise and metadata; never flatten metadata into stream labels. Engine log text is the raw content between its delimiters (no unescaping), unlike Go AST table strings. Reset only on clear, not between cases.
replay.hints: hint_expression is inert original Go source. The single hinted row, errors hints (197-207), uses NewParserHint([]string{"__error__"}, nil, false, true, ""); the other 15 use NoParserHints(). Pulse's public API does not expose this hint object. An ordinary unhinted JSON-stage replay can compare its frozen error oracle, but cannot claim to exercise the upstream hinted builder, extraction selection or short-circuit behavior. Do not discard the row or rewrite want to accommodate missing hint support.
replay.in_block_expression: Keep the complete ownership fixture at 159-170: its third evaluation at 169-170 is an explicit-fields json sl, md, sm, tri control, marked parser_form=explicit_fields. The other 41 engine cases are parser_form=parse_all. This preserves the complete requested fixture without importing the later explicit-path grammar block at 283 onward.
replay.json_paths: want_json_path and json_path_expression preserve all original expected maps as inert provenance. Upstream NewJSONParser(true) tracks paths; its harness only checks keys in nonempty maps and does not assert absence of other paths. Pulse's public API exposes no path map: ordinary replay compares want, not these internal maps, and makes no path-tracking claim.
replay.metrics: mode=instant has equal start/end and step=0; mode=range has its explicit step. outcome=series uses exact combined label maps and original numeric-string slots at start+i*step. An underscore means a missing point, never zero or an omitted whole series. No selected case explicitly expects an empty result. outcome=reject has the exact upstream expected message substring in reject (JSONParserErr), not a full HTTP error body. Preserve complete __error_details__ strings in series/entry labels, including original conversion-error text. Internal SampleExtractionErr overriding JSONParserErr and the ordinary metadata key __preserve_error__ are unmodified source expectations, not Pulse-derived behavior.
replay.requirements: Normal replay reads committed JSON using Elixir/Rust JSON only, without Go, network or expectation generation. The producer is optional provenance tooling, not a build/test dependency.
replay.select: mode=select uses direction, start/end and step=0. outcome=entries uses expected_entries: labels is the stream owner only; metadata and parsed are separate per-entry owners. Missing clauses become empty maps. Compare all categories, input text and relative timestamp, following logqltest/runner.go:490-545. Empty expected/expected_entries arrays are mode placeholders, NOT expect-empty assertions.
replay.table: Each table row is one upstream evaluation (not strict/non-strict variants). base_labels is the initial stream owner; structured_metadata is attached after builder reset and before parsing; initial_parsed_labels={} records no preexisting parsed labels. want is the exact flat LabelsResult().Labels() assertion, NOT a categorized oracle. Preserve input line bytes and verify input immutability if replaying a mutable parser. metadata_expression preserves original nil versus a Go map; nil metadata has the same empty owner represented by {} for replay.
